# Safety and observation requirements checklist: Supervisor start command, role advice, and the dispatch roles block

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements for the fail-closed command and for the read-only validator observation are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable.
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command from the spec, the plan, and the contracts.
It uses the defaults for a run with no interactive answers: standard depth, a pull request reviewer as the audience, and the two focus areas with the most risk (the command that spawns a supervisor, and the observation of another tool's configuration).
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec say whether a project may have more than one supervisor that `supervisor start` made, and what the command does when a supervisor already exists? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the requirements for two `supervisor start` calls that run at the same time defined? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the owner's way to stop or remove a supervisor that the command started stated, or is its absence an explicit exclusion? [Gap, Out of scope]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the requirements for the first prompt complete for a prompt that is long, multi-line, or starts with `--`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec state what the command prints for a script, such as a machine-readable thread ID, or is the first-line form of the output only a contract detail? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the extra latency of the validator read stated for a hand-off on a remote machine, where the read starts a host terminal and may take up to its bound? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Are "first session" and "first turn" used for the same moment, or do they name two different moments the spec must tell apart? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §User story 1]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "the same kind of environment as a worker" (a managed worktree off the default branch on the default host) stated in the requirement itself and not only in the assumptions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "a line that names the validator's agent and its readiness" specific enough to be checked without the contract file? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "the host that runs the pipeline" defined for a task on the host that holds the clone, and for a task on a remote machine? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "readiness" defined as what bb reports for the provider, and is the limit stated that it does not prove that no-mistakes can start the agent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the spec say what "could not be observed" covers, so that the cases in the edge-case list and the cases in FR-020 are the same set? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020]

## Requirement consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do FR-005 (no admission rule for a supervisor) and the hard rules in the constitution agree about a supervisor with permission mode `full` that can answer the owner's approval form (D-030)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Do FR-021 (the hand-off is never refused because of the observation) and FR-022 and FR-023 (the preflight and a remote dispatch are refused) give a reason that a reader can find in one place? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the user stories and the functional requirements use the same name for the same thing (`validator_agent`, "validator line", "observation")? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the success criteria that count tests (SC-005, SC-006, SC-007) consistent with the stated rule that success criteria describe outcomes and not the tests that check them? [Consistency, Spec §Success criteria]

## Acceptance criteria quality

- [ ] CHK017 Can SC-002 ("4 of 4 supervisor tools and its skill on its first request") be measured on a harness whose log the maintainer cannot read? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-006 ("0 commands write to no-mistakes configuration") defined over a stated set of commands, and is that set named? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK019 Does every acceptance scenario of user story 4 name an observable result, and not only a state of the system? [Measurability, Spec §User story 4]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the live proof that S9 passes on four harnesses a criterion of the feature or an assumption about the environment, given that it needs four installed command-line tools? [Dependency, Spec §User story 6]

## Scenario and edge case coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for a `dispatch.json` that changes between the check of the profile and the spawn? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a no-mistakes configuration file that is large, binary, or has a byte-order mark? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the requirements for an `agent` entry that names a bb provider which is ready but has been disabled by the owner defined? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the behavior defined when the observation succeeds on the server but the task's machine has been deleted before the hand-off? [Exception Flow, Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## Non-functional requirements

- [ ] CHK025 Is a requirement stated that the evidence line must not echo any other part of the no-mistakes configuration, which can hold paths and tokens? [Gap, Security, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the read bound (30 seconds) justified, and is the behavior when the bound is met the same for the server and for a remote machine? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]

## Dependencies and assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Is the assumption validated that bb applies `pluginMetadata` from the spawn call before the first session of every provider, and is it stated what happens if a bb version stops doing so? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption validated that no-mistakes keeps its `agent` setting in the global file and not in the repository's file, and is a way to learn that it changed stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the table from no-mistakes agent to bb provider documented as a dependency with an owner, since a new agent in no-mistakes makes it stale? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the dependency on an installed `sh` on every remote machine documented, given that the observation and the existing preflight both run `sh -c`? [Dependency, Spec §FR-016]

## Notes

- Check items off as you complete them (`[x]`).
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Items are numbered CHK001 and up and are never renumbered.
- `/speckit-implement` reads the checkbox state of this file and never changes it.
